recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future badge, notification-format, or pipeline-monitoring adjustments should be handled as infrastructure maintenance rather than remaining FHIR-3127 reconciliation work.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core documentation enhancement asking for a FHIR build status page, ideally backed by continuous integration that builds after every commit.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-3127 commit was found in repository history or on the combined reconciliation branch. Jira comments say the request was done in October 2014, and an April 2014 SVN-origin commit by Josh Mandel added Travis CI wiring, README build documentation, and build.sh support for a Continuous Integration Build published at build.fhir.org.
additional_context: The build-status mechanism has since evolved to Azure pipelines. The current README exposes CI build badges and build.fhir.org links; master and pull-request pipeline definitions run the publisher, upload successful builds to build.fhir.org or branch-specific locations, and post success/failure notifications to the Zulip FHIR Build Status topic. The live build.fhir.org current build, QA page, and branch list are reachable.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current repository and live build infrastructure already provide CI build status, current build publication, QA output, branch build publication, and build-result notifications.
